summary: Iter 11 retest: BOTH fixes from iter 10 PASS. FIX 1 — Profile menu leak resolved: profile.tsx MENU const (lines 16-26) no longer contains 'Demo Accounts' or 'Trial Mode'; those two rows exist only in DEMO_MENU (lines 39-46) which is rendered inside the `{testMode && (...)}` guard. Playwright verified with a fresh session (localStorage cleared): navigating to /profile shows menu-edit-profile but menu-demo-accounts, menu-trial, and menu-admin are all absent. After setting localStorage.intro_test_mode='1' + reload: menu-demo-accounts, menu-trial, menu-admin, menu-metrics, and disable-test-mode all become visible under 'Test & Trial Tools'. FIX 2 — /api/nearby privacy resolved: server.py compute_nearby (lines 873-896) and synthetic_nearby (lines 790-813) no longer emit 'lat'/'lng' keys. pytest test_iter11_privacy_fix.py: 4/4 PASS covering (a) kauri demo-login + /api/nearby regular list (lat/lng stripped, distance+bearing kept), (b) high_density_demo=true via PUT /api/users/me/state → 100 users returned including hd-* synthetic profiles, no lat/lng on any of them, (c) fresh @example.com regular user register+/api/nearby → no lat/lng leak, (d) response-shape regression (id/name/vibe/distance/bearing/compatible all present, distance & bearing numeric). REGRESSION — Radar map: kauri demo-login (test mode enabled to reveal login-demo button) → tap Radar tab → radar-map testID renders, 12 radar-blip-* elements + multiple radar-cluster-* bubbles + radar-zoom-in/out + radar-recentre + radar-radius-chip (Radius: 500m — pro plan) + radius rings (75m, 250m, 500m labels visible). Tapping a blip opens the marker preview overlay with 'About 40m away' (Maya, 27 · Need Advice); zero console errors mentioning undefined lat/lng. REGRESSION — Nearby list: still renders with '60 nearby · Showing your best 12' header, category chips (Networking/Social/Campus/…), mode cards (Hiring/Founders/Advice), and see-more-nearby row all visible. Push notifications intentionally MOCKED (not flagged). Only carry-over noise: shadow* deprecation warnings from theme.ts and a benign background /api 401 during pre-login state.

react_native_issues.issue: Carry-over from iter 5–10: Expo Web console emits 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' Cosmetic only, no functional impact. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts.

action_items: OPTIONAL (carry-over): migrate deprecated shadow* style props in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts to boxShadow to silence Expo Web console warnings. Non-blocking for beta.
critical_code_review_comments: profile.tsx: MENU const (lines 16-26) is now cleanly a public-only list; DEMO_MENU (lines 39-46) is gated by `{testMode && (...)}` at line 223. No demo-tool leakage.

server.py compute_nearby (lines 873-896) and synthetic_nearby (lines 790-813) emit only distance + bearing (no lat/lng). Radar client uses these plus a client-side bearing/distance projection — verified by successful map render with 12 blips + clusters + rings.
Backend still stores lat/lng internally on the user document (as expected); those are used server-side to compute distance/bearing and never returned in the /nearby users[] payload.

success_rate.backend: 4/4 (100%) — kauri /api/nearby regular list has no lat/lng; HD demo (100 users incl. hd-* synthetics) has no lat/lng; fresh @example.com user /api/nearby has no lat/lng; response shape (distance+bearing numeric) intact.

rca_of_issue: Both fixes correctly implemented: (1) menu-demo-accounts + menu-trial removed from MENU array in profile.tsx (kept only in DEMO_MENU); (2) 'lat'/'lng' keys removed from the dict literal returned by both compute_nearby and synthetic_nearby in server.py — distance + bearing are the only positional signals now leaving the server. No further action needed.
